definition: Expecting immediate obedience and allowing no refusal or discussion.
author: Emily Brontë
quote: No plan offered itself: the very exhibition of any desire to keep him would have rendered the claimant more peremptory: there was nothing left but to resign him.
example_sentence: The cat gave a peremptory meow at exactly six o'clock.
